items.title: Don Alias interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 6, 2002
items.q: The interviewer asks 'And Alan Dawson. Did you have a defined goal at that time?' The interviewee responds about his general attitude towards ambition and playing, without mentioning any personal interaction, relationship, or specific knowledge of Alan Dawson.

ctx.x: And Alan Dawson. Did you have a defined goal at that time? Like I want to be — I’m not saying this very well, but like — a star in music. Was that a goal or was it just kind of—

No. Never. Never. You know I’m focused in a certain way in terms of let me do the best that I can on this thing. Not what am I going to get from it, endorsements or whatever. Just let me do the best I can and then whatever comes will come. I never — and I don’t know if that was a help or a hindrance — I never really really was ambitious about a career you know. It was just play your ass off and do the best you can. And somehow or another that worked. The ambition came with the playing. I mean all of a sudden you…
